data.raw_text:
In Church News Today this Tuesday, Dec. 2:

Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles recently ministered to members in Cebu City, Philippines. Elder and Sister Kearon met with more than 100 people who are working to recover from twin typhoons and an earthquake. In one private meeting, the Kearons offered comfort to a family grieving the death of their 7-year-old daughter who died during the flooding.

The First Presidency has announced the May 3, 2026, dedication of the Davao Philippines Temple by Elder Dale G. Renlund of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. The dedication of the southernmost house of the Lord in the Southeast Asia island nation will be that day’s second, followed by the Lindon Utah Temple dedication.

Christmas lights have been turned on at Temple Square, with other holiday events and activities planned in and around Church headquarters in Salt Lake City. You can read about these articles and more — including about other Christmas lights and Church-sponsored events worldwide — at https://t.co/B1pkIb5smK or on the Church News app.
